graph.title: LEGO City 7992 Container Stacker (containers, pallet, minifig and crane truck)
notes: The booklet builds several models from two bags: bag 1 gives the red container, the gray container with hook mount, the pallet with 4 gas tanks, 2 barrels and the orange minifig. Bag 2 gives the Container Stacker crane truck. All are in one graph.

Element IDs were read from the small inventory page, which is low-resolution. A few IDs may be misread. Where an ID matches a catalogue entry I used that entry, even if its description differs slightly (e.g. lego-4211063, lego-4211002 and lego-4211805 are used for the pieces that look like a black plate 1x2, a black plate 1x6/1x8 and the gray rear axle).
The rear axle lego-4211805 only has an anti-stud port in the catalogue, so its edges use null ports.

The black underside plates of both containers (a pinwheel of four small plates plus edge strips) could not be matched to the inventory counts. Only the four lego-4211056 plates are included, as two edge strips per container. The pinwheel plates are omitted.
Hazard stripes on the gray container are shown as one printed tile (b28) with a contact edge. Stickers (Max. 10 T, globe) are not parts.

The stud-by-stud placement of the truck body (green plates, bricks, slopes, black plates and fenders) is inferred from the small perspective drawings. Parts are joined to the plausible supporting piece below, and some attachments may be off by one position.

Carrier sub-assembly: a yellow 2x4 plate with two white Technic bricks flanking the two chassis beams. carrier1 is the red/rear end (single wheels on the gray axle). carrier2 is the front/headlight end (dual wheels on the black axle).
The 4 gas-tank caps (lego-614126) are joined to the tanks with null ports because the catalogue entry describes the part as a small wheel.
The minifig is shown standing beside the truck at the end, not seated, so it has no edge to the truck.

All 4 lego-4210690 pillars are used: 2 posts on the tan pins and 2 stacked on top (assumed). The piston rods enter their top holes. The elbow pieces lego-4494486 are mounted on the gray pins in the boom and carry the piston connectors.
